deviations: Dedupe (R0 asked for one deploy per commit): pushes deploy only through the workflow_call job in ci.yml; the workflow_run path deploys pull_request runs only, never push or workflow_dispatch runs. Production therefore only ever comes from a push to main.
The alias also drops leading '-' (a DNS label cannot start with one); the brief only names trailing.
Previews run in a GitHub environment named 'preview' (GitHub creates it on first use) so the URL shows as an environment link; production uses 'production' as specified.
The PR comment edits the bot's last comment (gh pr comment --edit-last --create-if-none, falling back to a new comment) instead of adding one per run.
Production deploys warn (not fail) when Netlify's site url differs from SITE_URL, read with the ARCHITECTURE §3.1 tsx command.

openQuestions.question: After launch, a claude/** branch with an open PR deploys the same commit twice by §14.3 design: the push run to the branch alias and the PR run to pr-<number>. Keep both aliases, or deploy PR runs only when the head branch is not pushed by ci (for example not claude/**)?

ci.yml's concurrency (cancel-in-progress per ref) can cancel a deploy that is still uploading when a newer push lands; the newer run deploys afterwards and the alias only moves on a finished deploy. Consider a required-reviewer or main-only rule on the 'production' environment.
